color: #757575;\"\u003ECBBLE UDHC SIMILAR CASES\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\" style=\"background-color: white; color: #757575;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EThis is an online E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\" style=\"background-color: white; color: #757575;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EInformant - Daughter in law\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\" style=\"color: #757575;\"\u003EA 85 year old man from Narketpally, who used to work as a merchant in a local market, came with chief complaints of uprolling\u0026nbsp;of eyes, frothing from mouth,and clenching of both fists at 3:30 pm on Saturday.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHistory of presenting illness\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/h4\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic on Saturday morning, had his lunch in the afternoon , sat on his bed, when he suddenly fell on the bed and developed clenching of his hands, uprolling of eyes and moving head to right side associated with frothing from mouth,\u0026nbsp; lasting for about 3 - 4 minutes.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo history of involuntary micturition or defecation, deviation of mouth, no history of\u0026nbsp; headache, nausea,vomitings prior to the event.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHistory of post ictal confusion present, patient was in drowsy state when brought to the hospital by the attenders.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPast history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h4\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 10 years back, he is a chronic alcoholic and chronic smoker , drinks around 90-180 ml of whisky and around 500ml of toddy daily and smokes about 3 -4 packets of beedis per day.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;He used to\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;work as a merchant at a local market, but stopped going to work due to regular alcohol consumption, which interfered with his work, as he used to drink during daytime and used to fall on roads in intoxication,\u0026nbsp; which made the family members to make him quit his work and stay at home. Since then, he stays at home , goes outside to drink alcohol ,chats with his friends and returns home.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003ESince the past 5-6 yrs, the attenders observed that he is forgetting things or events. He used to smoke beedis\u0026nbsp;at home regularly which he personally keeps them at a particular place but forgets about it and asks family members\u0026nbsp; sometimes. Forgets events like whether he had lunch or not sometimes.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EFails to identify his family members and close relatives who visit their house on and off.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EThe attenders attributed all these symptoms to his chronic alcoholism and were used to taking care of his daily activities,\u0026nbsp; like guiding him to the bathroom, giving him clothes to dress.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe was once a well known person around his locality, settling any disputes or quarrels in his area, actively participating in local events. He gradually became less interested in those activities and usually stays at his home or goes to his daughter's house nearby.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E3 years back , he attended a local wedding ceremony at night, had history of vomiting and involuntary defecation and micturition in the morning in his bed associated with uprolling of eyes and blinking, frothing from mouth and clenching of both fists,\u0026nbsp; which lasted for around 10 -15 minutes, with post ictal confusion. Patient brought to hospital, necessary clinical examination and investigations were done. MRI brain showed\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ELeft occipital old insult with glinting changes, age relate cerebral and cerebellum atrophy, small vessel ischemic changes and periventricular leukaraiosis.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe got discharged the next day with ? Tab.phenytoin 100mg once daily( attender not sure of name of the drug,said it was in a bottle with 100 tablets) and used to take once in the morning.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe was forced to quit alcohol by the attenders\u0026nbsp; since then, but still drinks around 250 ml of toddy once a week and smokes atleast one packet of beedis per day.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe limited going out of his house( regularly goes to shop in front of his home to buy beedis) , or goes to his daughter's house which is few streets away. He used to have irritable behavior and used to get angry and raise his his hands on his family members.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003ESince the past 4-5 months, stopped taking antiepileptics ( due to cost issues and as he is seizure free for around 2 years).\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe is not a known case of diabetes, hypertension, bronchial asthma,tuberculosis, coronary artery disease or thyroid disorders.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPersonal history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h4\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe wakes up around 5 am ,goes to bathroom, roams around in the home,completes his bath, has to smoke his beedis, has his breakfast , again smokes, takes a nap for few hours. Has his lunch, sometimes goes outside to chat with his friends,sleeps for few hours, has his smoke, returns home, sleeps at around 9 pm after dinner. Easily wakes up during sleep on slight sounds at night.he stays with his wife, son, daughter in law and his grandkids.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EDrug history\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h4\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E? disease\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI -\u0026nbsp; 96 patients\u0026nbsp; were given donepezil 5mg for first 6 weeks, with escalation to 10 mg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;57 patients given placebo\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC - primary efficacy measure was Alzheimer disease assessment scale- cognitive subspace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Secondary efficacy measure was MMSE, Computerized memory battery test, patient global assessment scale and apathy scale.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThese were compared between two groups at weeks 12 and 24 and at end point.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EO - donepezil group showed more improvement than the placebo group.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr
